scope: Offline demo only; no canonical source, engine, release configuration or backend changes

guardrailImpact.execution: Full regression plus all runtime/persistence/multi-device guardrail groups; canonical release and security tests remain mandatory

legacyPolicy.runtimeSchema: Unchanged schemaVersion=2; existing valid sessions preserved
legacyPolicy.behavior: One-time retained-legacy explanation before mounting the runtime UI; explicit acknowledgement; no counter migration and no legacy deletion
legacyPolicy.corruptLegacy: Bounded unrecognized-format explanation, no raw value; preserve bytes
legacyPolicy.storageFailure: Fail closed to a fixed retry view; never falsely acknowledge
legacyPolicy.restartAndReset: Acknowledgement is separate from runtime; reset never clears it
legacyPolicy.detectionBoundary: Detect retained legacy data, not installation history. If legacy data is absent, no reliable inference of an earlier installed version is possible; no historical state or migration is invented.

diagnosticPolicy.entry: Long press persistent DEMO banner; confirm export; view bounded JSON preview; optional native share only after a second explicit action
diagnosticPolicy.clinicalControls: No permanent clinical diagnostic buttons or production routes
diagnosticPolicy.distributionBoundary: Existing standalone offline-demo build remains distributable=false and publicationAuthorization=NOT_GRANTED
diagnosticPolicy.source: One actual persisted demo runtime row; validate complete existing schema and real domain reconstruction; do not substitute UI/in-memory command list
diagnosticPolicy.processingStatusMeaning: APPLIED_EVENT_VERIFIED is a diagnostic classification from a validated persisted command and matching BINDER_APPLIED event/effect, not an invented stored/server lifecycle field
diagnosticPolicy.errors: Fixed DEMO_ACCEPTANCE_UNAVAILABLE; no raw error, logging or network fallback
diagnosticPolicy.neverSavedSession: No persisted proof is fabricated; user first uses a supported save-producing navigation/action
diagnosticPolicy.sharing: No automatic share or upload. For physical acceptance inspect the local preview or choose an explicitly approved local evidence destination. Do not publish.

resetReceipt.source: Validated actual persisted row before and after a successful supported reset
resetReceipt.invariants: New session identity, generation+1, new time zero; receipt must bind to current persisted identity/generation
resetReceipt.atomicityBoundary: Runtime reset remains one primary atomic SQLite upsert. Receipt is a secondary best-effort write, not an atomic multi-row claim. Missing/interrupted/stale receipt explicitly yields NOT_AVAILABLE; it cannot undo runtime reset or fabricate successful transition proof.
resetReceipt.unknownPriorState: Corrupt or never-persisted prior runtime may be safely reset, but no verified before/after receipt is claimed

futurePhysicalProcedure: Separately authorize a new signed demo APK with versionCode greater than installed 2; proposed next candidate 3 requires availability verification and consistent metadata update before build
In-place upgrade only the demo; preserve canonical APK 181, existing valid v2 runtime and retained v1 key
With retained v1 data confirm one-time explanation, acknowledge, restart and confirm no repeated notice
Verify existing v2 state is retained; no claim that the old counter was migrated
Offline, open a supported demo mode so a row exists; long-press DEMO banner and confirm preview; capture actual persisted ID/count/generation/time/status
If session has no command, perform one supported binder action; otherwise reuse its existing accepted command; never duplicate solely for evidence
Pause and capture persisted commandCount=1, actual command ID and APPLIED_EVENT_VERIFIED; restart and compare
Capture pre-reset evidence, use supported reset confirmation, preview persisted count=0/time=0/generation+1 and PERSISTED_BEFORE_AND_AFTER transition
Restart; verify same reset generation and receipt; no upgrade notice retrigger and no stale updates
If receipt is NOT_AVAILABLE, report the exact evidence gap; do not fabricate proof or reset repeatedly without a scoped plan
Restore original network state and verify canonical coexistence with read-only UI; preserve evidence locally
